summary.name: Redmine
summary.one_liner: Redmine is a self-hostable, open source project management web application built on Ruby on Rails with issue tracking, Gantt charts, wiki, forums and time tracking.
summary.what_it_does: Redmine is a flexible project management web application that can be self-hosted and configured for different ways of working. It supports multiple projects, role-based access control, and a flexible issue tracking system with custom fields. It also includes Gantt charts, a calendar, news, documents and file management, per-project wikis and forums, and time tracking. It integrates with SCM systems (Subversion, Git, Mercurial, Bazaar and CVS), supports issue creation via email, and offers LDAP authentication and user self-registration.
notable: Written in Ruby on Rails, cross-platform and cross-database
Built-in SCM integration with Subversion, Git, Mercurial, Bazaar and CVS
Multilanguage support and multiple LDAP authentication support
caveats: An online demo at demo.redminecloud.net is unofficial and third-party, not connected to Redmine.org
